## 🛡️ Security and privacy review

- [ ] Authentication and authorization behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Upstream allowlist prevents arbitrary destination forwarding.
- [ ] Header filtering and trusted proxy behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Request/response size and timeout limits considered.
- [ ] Retry and idempotency behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Secrets and sensitive data are not included.
- [ ] Logging and telemetry are redacted.
- [ ] Threat model updated when risk changes.
